news.headline: MAJOR FLOODING FRI — St. Johns River near Cocoa hit 18.7 ft at about 10 AM Fri, a new record more than a foot above the 1953 record of 17.6 ft; NWS Melbourne Flood Warning remains in effect until further notice (river was 18.6 ft at 2:15 AM, flood stage 16.0 ft), with a Flood Watch for east-central Florida including Orange, Osceola, Seminole, Volusia and Brevard through Fri 7 PM and flash flood warnings in Brevard Fri morning
news.source: National Weather Service, Melbourne / Florida Today

news.headline: Construction set to begin within months on Roche Bobois St. Pete Tower — 29-story, 164-unit condo tower at 344 4th Street South in St. Petersburg, a $200 million project by Valor Capital, with about 40% of units already under contract

U.S. housing starts rose 9.9% in October to a 1.309 million annual rate — single-family starts up 4.0% to 864,000 — but building permits fell 7.4% to 1.295 million, lowest since May 2020, with single-family permits down 8.7% to 772,000, lowest since January 2023; builder confidence fell 4 points to 25 in November, lowest since April 2012, with 46% of builders cutting prices

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31 — permit application date governs which edition applies; Miami-Dade portal cutoff is 4 PM Dec 30, with new flood documentation and coastal corrosion rules

Copper eases Fri — LME copper closed at $12,453/ton, down 1.37% in overnight trading Fri Nov 20, and COMEX copper was $5.53/lb, down 1.88%, as of 8:59 AM EST Fri, near a seven-month low after a sharp mid-November selloff

MasTec to acquire Murphy Corporation for about $1.25 billion in cash — Murphy, a large mechanical contractor serving mission-critical markets with HVAC, plumbing and process work, is projected to generate about $775 million in 2026 revenue and about $140 million in Adjusted EBITDA, with about 1,600 employees including about 1,200 union craft professionals

Fed minutes read hawkish — almost all October FOMC participants judged further rate hikes likely to return inflation to 2%; funds held at 3.75–4.00%, next meeting Dec 8–9, with markets pricing about 97% odds of a December hike on Fri morning

Markets fell hard Thu Nov 19 — S&P 500 down 2.02% to 7,175.83 for a sixth straight loss, Dow down 2.19% to 49,097.06 and Nasdaq down 2.25% to 23,879.20, VIX at 28.44; Freddie Mac said the 30-year fixed mortgage averaged 7.28% for the week ending Nov 19, up 17 basis points from 7.11%, with the 15-year at 6.66%

NBA: Heat 137, Bucks 130 on Wed night — Bam Adebayo 26 pts (21 in the first half), Giannis Antetokounmpo 27 pts for Milwaukee, Miami's win reported Thu; 76ers 121, Magic 116 — Joel Embiid 26 pts, VJ Edgecombe 24, halting Orlando's four-game winning streak; Magic play tonight Fri Nov 20 at the Brooklyn Nets, 7:30 PM ET
NFL Sun Nov 22 — all Florida teams on the road: Buccaneers (3-6) at Lions (7-2) 1 PM ET, Dolphins (1-8) at Bills (8-1) 1 PM ET, Jaguars (7-2) at Giants (5-3-1) 4:25 PM ET
